headline: Developed European Equities and Cyclical Sectors Gain Relative Leadership as Semiconductor Strength Softens
market_regime: Broadening leadership with strength shifting toward European developed markets, US cyclicals, and value factors
executive_summary: Quantitative analysis reveals relative strength strengthening in European developed markets (FEZ, VGK) and selected US cyclicals such as Materials (XLB) and Energy (XLE). Technology sub-sectors exhibit divergence: software and cloud exposures (SKYY, IGV) maintain persistent leadership, while semiconductors (SMH) have transitioned into ROTATION_OUT. Direct pair signals highlight relative leadership shifting from Growth to Value, with IWD leading IWF across both 20-bar and 63-bar spreads.
